feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 September 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 23 September 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system which will move quickly across the Irish Sea this morning, ridge of high pressure will then build later today.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later in the morning or early afternoon, 3 or 4 in evening, before becoming Variable 2 or 3 for a time tonight. Settling South or Southeast 4 or 5 later in night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight later today.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first, possibly heavy. but quickly clearing this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, although a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay. Little change for the rest of the day, then veering West 3 or 4 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate in places for a time.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain later.
